window_policy: Complete half-open windows; skip all methods if no quality candidate.
selection_policy: Timed: latest in window. Quality: pass exposure/contrast checks and have gyro data; equal midranks for higher road sharpness and lower preceding 0.2 s gyro RMS; break ties by sharpness, then latest frame.
transition_policy: Compare successive inferred labels within each method and interval. Include unknown. Skip missing windows. First prediction establishes the baseline.
